```{r}

install.package(dplyr)
install.package(imager)
setwd()
library(reticulate) #package to access python libraries
use_python("C:/Windows/py.exe", required = T)
np <- import("numpy", convert = F)
library(dplyr)
labels <- read.csv("../data/styles.csv",
                     header= T) %>%
  unique(.)

#subset to 10,000 images. indexes are already random
labels <- labels[1:10000,]

images <- list.files("../data/images")
images  <- gsub(".jpg", "",images)
images <- images[images %in% labels$id]
#number of images is 9995. there are some photos not in label sheet

#get true labels
labels <- labels[labels$id %in% images,]

#get image paths again
images <- paste0("../data/images/",images, ".jpg")

library(imager)
photos <- lapply(images, load.image)
dim(photos[[1]]) #3 channels RGB #60 80 1 3
summary(photos[[50]]) #not 8 bit pixelated, scale is 0 to 1

library(tensorflow)
library(keras)

images <- np$load("C:/Users/maris/OneDrive/Documents/resume and cv and cl/wgu/neural_networks/classification-images/images.npy")
images_for_r <- py_to_r(images)
class(images_for_r)
dim(images_for_r) #128h x 128w with 3 color channels; 128 * 128 = 16,384 individual pixels
summary(images_for_r[1,,,]) #first image pixel summary
```

```{r image preview}

indexed_labels <- as.data.frame(c("Label" = labels,
                                  "Observation" = seq(1,length(labels), by =1) ))

few_images_indexes <- indexed_labels[1:4,]
few_images <- images_for_r[1:4,,,]

few_normalized <- few_images / 255

#install.packages("BiocManager")
library(BiocManager)
#BiocManager::install("EBImage")
library(EBImage)

subset_ready <- aperm(few_normalized, c(3, 2, 4, 1)) #switch order of dimensions- count, h, w, rgb
image_stack <- Image(subset_ready, colormode = 'Color') #rgb

display(image_stack, method = "raster", all = TRUE) #display
text(x = 10,  y = 20,  labels = "Small-flowered Cranesbill", col = "yellow", cex = 1.2, adj = 0)

############repeat for other classes

few_images <- images_for_r[1:4,,,]
```

```{r label distribution}

distribution <- as.data.frame(table(labels))
barplot(table(labels),
        axes = T,
        horiz = T)

library(ggplot)
ggplot(data = distribution, aes(x = Label, y = Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "darkblue") +
  #theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) + # Rotate and adjust alignment
  labs(title = "Label Distribution")

#uneven distribution
```

```{r data augmentation}
n_samples <- nrow(labels)
n_categories <- nrow(unique(labels))

#weights to match up to majority class, majority class has lowest weight
weights <- n_samples / (n_samples * distribution$Freq) #outputs weights for each class

#make a list for keras
class_weights <- vector()
for (i in 1:length(weights)) {
  class_index <- as.character(i - 1)
  #print(class_index)
  # Assign the weight to that specific class index
  class_weights[[class_index]] <- weights[i]
}
```
